title: プロジェクトデザインⅢ(神宮英夫研究室)
subtitle: Design Project III(Jingu Hideo)
educationalGoal: The aim is to propose a service that is reflected the function of the mind and the planning/development of a product that is safe, comfortable, and fun to use. Students work on theme, while making use of psychological knowledge and measurement/evaluation techniques acquired so far.
advice: This course is required for Certified Psychologists. Lectures, practice exercises, and experiment are carried out as needed. Presentations and discussions are held appropriately. At the end of the previous semester, activities are presented in the department presentation time. At the end of the academic year, the one-year results are presented collectively. Students participate in a seminar every week and work on a problem until the following week. In the seminar every week, activity contents of the week are reported. The themes are Kansei engineering, ergonomics, product development, and brand management, etc. Collaborative investigation with professional research workers and the external persons is important. The themes are continuously progressed while adhering to deadlines and schedules and students can learn about business interactions. At the end of the second semester, a presentation is evaluated by research workers and the external persons and students can obtain their guidances.
requiredKnowledge: This course cannot be completed if students are absent from weekly seminars and do not submit reports. Review the specialized subjects you have studied so far and work on Design Project III actively.

activityGoals.body: Ability to explain the function of the mind.
Ability to use techniques of measurement/evaluation for the function of the mind.
Ability to explain the process of manufacturing by Kansei engineering.
Ability to practice your activity program voluntarily.
Ability to obtain behavior guidance for your future career.
